acceptance_evidence: Red/green test output captured in the ledger
completion_conditions: Both copies return list(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_CHECKS) when mergegate.required_checks is an inline scalar.
A regression test pins the scalar shape for both copies and fails before the change.
validate_shiki.config_required_checks() still raises ValidationError on the scalar shape, evidenced in the ledger.
non_goals: Do not change .shiki/config.yaml or any workflow file.
Do not change any argv or CLI surface; tests/test_workflow_invocation.py stays untouched and green.
Do not change scripts/validate_shiki.py; it already rejects the shape loudly.
Do not touch tests/test_config_loading.py; PR #357 holds an active lock on it.
Do not change the load_shiki_config parser itself.
outcome: configured_required_checks in scripts/shiki_config.py and scripts/mergegate_check.py treat a non-list mergegate.required_checks as absent and fall back to DEFAULT_REQUIRED_CHECKS, instead of walking the string character by character; validate_shiki.py remains the loud rejector of the invalid shape.
title: Required-checks derivation must never iterate a scalar config value
